b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool for downloading data from URLs.

## Command Line Options

| Option | Short | Long | Description |
|--------|-------|------|-------------|
| `url` | - | - | what to download |
| `-o` | --output | - | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q` | --quiet | - | no progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
python3 -m app.cli https://example.com/data

# Download to a file
python3 -m app.cli https://example.com/data -o output.txt

# Download silently
python3 -m app.cli https://example.com/data --quiet
```
'
